decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis drop occurs at indices 615–618 (N, E, U), with partial recovery in E and U but not N through index 623. The absence of a clear opposing return on N and incomplete rebound on E/U prevent confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain. No other temporary intervals within allowed context [580,660] meet the criteria.

intervals.observation: N drops sharply ~2 MAD over indices 615–618 and remains offset; E drops ~2.5 MAD over 615–617 then recovers partially by 623; U drops ~3 MAD over 615–618 and recovers partially by 623. Return is incomplete in N, ambiguous in E/U: no clear opposing edge before 624. Sustained interior (619–623) shows offset without reversal.
